description: This Java class defines a SawOscillator, which is a subclass of SynthUnit. It generates a sawtooth waveform by managing frequency, amplitude, phase, and phase increment, and provides methods to set and get properties. The render method produces the current sample of the waveform based on the phase and amplitude.

classes.name: SawOscillator
classes.description: A waveform generator producing a sawtooth signal, used in audio synthesis.

methods.name: setPitch
methods.description: Converts a pitch value to frequency and updates the oscillator's frequency accordingly.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the oscillator's frequency and updates phase increment.

methods.name: updatePhaseIncrement
methods.description: Calculates the phase increment based on the current frequency and scale.

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude of the oscillator.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Sets the frequency scaler and updates phase increment.

methods.name: incrementWrapPhase
methods.description: Increments the phase and wraps it around between -1.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the current sample of the waveform based on phase and amplitude.
